verdict.line: You lose this if you trade autos into an active Counter Strike or let his Empower-boosted Leap Strike catch you out of position; you win it by poking with Parrrley from range and banking the lane and solo-kill edge the data already gives you.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) only dodges incoming basic attacks and stuns on landing — it does nothing to Parrrley, which is a ranged ability, not an auto. That single fact is why Gangplank holds the lane and solo-kill edge here: you can poke through his main defensive tool for free, while he has to land his Leap Strike (Q) engage and Empower (W) auto-reset cleanly to punish you back.

theirWindow.when: Jax leaps in with Empower loaded
theirWindow.what: His W (Empower) makes the next attack or Leap Strike hit you and anyone nearby for bonus damage. If his E (Counter Strike) is also up when he commits, don't answer with autos — he dodges them and stuns you on the follow-up. Back off and kite with Parrrley instead.

yourWindow.what: Counter Strike is his only answer to sustained trading, and it's on an 18/16/14/12/10s cooldown by rank. The moment it's spent, walk up and auto-trade freely — he has no way to dodge or stun you until it resets.

start.why: 53.7% win rate over 2112 games; the AD and sustain let you win early auto trades before his Counter Strike comes online at level 3.

boots.why: 54.1% win rate over 1324 games; Jax's whole kit is auto-attack reliant (Empower resets, R stacks attack speed on every third hit), so flat physical reduction directly blunts his damage.

core.why: Mana sustain and AD let you spam Parrrley (5s cooldown) and Raise Morale without running dry mid-trade.
Execute threshold and crit turn a landed Parrrley into a kill threat Counter Strike can't block.
Crit scaling makes every Parrrley and empowered Raise Morale window hit much harder in the mid-game.

situational.when: jax stacks bonus health from his passive and other items and starts shrugging off your crits
you need a lifeline against his all-in windows rather than pure damage
you want extra mobility and burst to punish his Leap Strike or Counter Strike cooldowns directly

runes.keystoneWhy: Its stacking burn layers with Grog-Soaked Blade poison on a kit built around a 5s Parrrley cooldown, rewarding constant poke rather than one-off burst.

summoners.why: 89.4% pick rate at 54% win rate; Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills once a Parrrley trade drops Jax low, and Flash covers you against his Leap Strike engage.

playing.title: Poke before level 3
playing.detail: Parrrley's 5s cooldown and 625 range let you chip Jax before his Counter Strike comes online around level 3 — bank the HP lead early.

playing.title: Never auto into Counter Strike
playing.detail: If you see him pop the stance, cancel the auto and fire Parrrley instead — it's an ability, not a basic attack, so it goes through untouched while his dodge window is wasted.

playing.title: Respect Empower at close range
playing.detail: W (Empower) resets on a 7/6/5/4/3s cooldown and makes his next attack or Leap Strike hit everyone nearby for bonus damage — don't stand in melee range when you're low and it's up.

playing.title: Punish his Leap Strike cooldown
playing.detail: Early ranks of Q sit at 17/14/11/8/5s — once he's used it to engage or reposition, he has no gap closer or escape until it resets, so shove the wave or extend the trade.

playing.title: Time Raise Morale to his commitment
playing.detail: Pop E right as you commit to a trade or his all-in starts, not on cooldown — the AD and movement speed window is what actually wins the exchange he started.

playing.title: Clear his stun, don't just sustain
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears any CC on you and heals — if Counter Strike's stun lands, use it to escape the follow-up rather than banking it as passive sustain.

playing.title: Play for tempo, not a forced all-in
playing.detail: The matchup sits at 53.4% over 2523 games despite your lane and solo-kill edge — keep the fight at range through his Counter Strike window instead of forcing level 3-5 all-ins where his stun can flip it.

brief.patchCaveat: The win rates, build order, boots, rune pages, and summoner spell splits are measured OP.GG stats for Gangplank vs Jax on the current patch; the ability-level reasoning — Counter Strike vs Parrrley, Empower timing, Leap Strike cooldown windows — is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Bring Scorch if you want to play aggressively. Use [E] the moment Jax uses Leap Strike (Q) to win lane.
